Build Trust.descriptionOnly: its +2 is on the caster's Charisma checks and Charisma-based skill checks with the target only; the reroll and the +1 trust score are told here

Conjuration Foil.descriptionOnly: on every creature in its area; the damage to a creature summoned or teleported in or out is told here

Cultural Adaptation.descriptionOnly: the +2 on Diplomacy doesn't stack with circumstance bonuses for being of the culture; the DCs of its charm spells against the culture's natives increase by 1, at the table

Entice Fey, Lesser.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are its damage or healing, DCs and saves against it, rolled at the table

Insect Spies.descriptionOnly: no path: the insects' numbers are their own (1 hit point, AC 20, +2 Dexterity, +8 size, Perception and Stealth by caster level), and the +16 on Perception to notice one climbing on a Tiny creature is that creature's

Majestic Image.descriptionOnly: while the caster inhabits the image; the object's size gives its Intimidate size bonus or penalty, at the table

Matchmaker.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are its damage or healing, DCs and saves against it, rolled at the table

Open Book.descriptionOnly: others' Diplomacy checks to gather information about the target gain half the caster level, +10 at most, at the table

Open and Shut.descriptionOnly: no path: the –5 on Perception checks regarding the door or what is beyond it is taken by those who believe the illusion, not by the door

Phantasmal Affliction.descriptionOnly: the poison's and the wasting's ability damage is rolled at the table; a creature immune to the affliction gets +4 on its Will save to disbelieve

Poisonous Balm.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are its damage or healing, DCs and saves against it, rolled at the table

Pox of Rumors.descriptionOnly: no path: the –4 on its daily saves when unaware of the rumors, and the scrying modifiers (+5 on another plane, –5 with a piece of its body) are on saves against it

Trace Teleport.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are its damage or healing, DCs and saves against it, rolled at the table

Trade Items.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are its damage or healing, DCs and saves against it, rolled at the table
